records.proposal: When you clearly answer a question that was put to you (a card shown in text, a question the agent asked in its reply, or Claude Code's question tool), plumb records your answer as your intent for that question and closes it, instead of turning your answer into a new request and asking it back on a card

When the owner's message clearly answers a question just put to them (a card shown in text or in the panel, a question in the agent's last reply, or the question tool's last question), the request check records that answer with the question, closes the card it answers, and raises no new card for the message; an unclear or partial answer leaves the question open
